video_title: Jimmy Butler is A BETTER player than Karl Anthony-Towns NO DOUBT 👀?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns Sr. criticizes Jimmy Butler
quotes.excerpt: It only hurt me as a father to hear people saying stuff that was negative that wasn't true
quotes.quote: It only hurt me as a father to hear people saying stuff that was negative that wasn't true to bring him down. But in the end, it all paid up. Jimmy ain't got no championship. Karl bypassed him.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Debating if Karl-Anthony Towns is better than Jimmy Butler
quotes.excerpt: Do we put Karl above Jimmy Butler?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Do we put Karl above Jimmy Butler?

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: I mean yeah. I mean if we making a list of who's top players in the league today.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: No, no, no. We're not saying today.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: All time. If their careers ended right now.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Yeah, I'll put Karl in front of him.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Butler's elite performance in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: When it fucking counts, Jimmy Butler is a savage.
quotes.quote: When it fucking counts, Jimmy Butler is a savage.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Butler's role in leading teams to the Finals
quotes.excerpt: Jimmy was the best player on the team to go to the finals multiple times.
quotes.quote: Jimmy was the best player on the team to go to the finals multiple times. And he had no business being there.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Butler's impact on his teams in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: When they made the playoffs in 2018, Jimmy Butler was the best player on that team.
quotes.quote: When they made the playoffs in 2018, Jimmy Butler was the best player on that team. When he made it with Ant, Ant was the best player. He played point in the Dallas Mavericks series. He's never been a number one. What are we talking about?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson and Karl-Anthony Towns' career growth
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson and Karl-Anthony Towns have made a huge jump over a lot of people.
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson and Karl-Anthony Towns have made a huge jump over a lot of people. They have made a major jump for what they did. But we can't discredit guys who done a lot of work in this league just because they didn't win a championship this year.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing big men to Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.excerpt: How many bigs are better than Karl? How many bigs will you take over Karl?
quotes.quote: How many bigs are better than Karl? How many bigs will you take over Karl? When I'm talking about bigs, we're talking about Jimmy Butler.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating Jimmy Butler's position on the court
quotes.excerpt: I would have to put him at a small forward because he's not that much of a shooting guard.
quotes.quote: I would have to put him at a small forward because he's not that much of a shooting guard.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Butler's ability to rise to the occasion
quotes.excerpt: Jimmy Butler has risen to the occasion more than most of those guys.
quotes.quote: Jimmy Butler has risen to the occasion more than most of those guys. A lot of those guys. We see Jimmy Butler do more than Jayson Tatum. But is he as talented as Jayson Tatum? As an individual, Jimmy Butler has done more than some of the best players.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Butler's success despite not winning a championship
quotes.excerpt: You can't put somebody above Jimmy Butler just because he has not won a championship.
quotes.quote: You can't put somebody above Jimmy Butler just because he has not won a championship. His team has not been as good as the teams he's been playing.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum's career compared to Jimmy Butler
quotes.excerpt: Jayson Tatum is above Jimmy Butler for me.
quotes.quote: Jayson Tatum is above Jimmy Butler for me. But what I'm not going to do is discredit Jimmy Butler for the team he had. He had no business being in the finals them two times. He had zero business. That is all I'm saying.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Karl-Anthony Towns and Jimmy Butler's careers
quotes.excerpt: I don't expect Jimmy to add a bunch more to his resume. But Karl has a chance.
quotes.quote: I don't expect Jimmy to add a bunch more to his resume. But Karl has a chance to add a lot. So the championship means that much. That's the only way. Because everything else goes to Jimmy. Jimmy is 36.
